occt-import-js 0.0.23 — unmodified browser distribution

Upstream/source: https://github.com/kovacsv/occt-import-js
Release package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/occt-import-js/v/0.0.23
Downloaded JS/WASM: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/occt-import-js@0.0.23/dist/
License: LGPL-2.1, see LICENSE.md. Upstream contains source and build instructions.
The JS and WASM files can be replaced together with a compatible rebuilt version.
test-cube.stp is the upstream simple-basic-cube test fixture.

This preserved release is not loaded by the application: Electron 9 does not
support its JavaScript syntax or WebAssembly exception handling. The application
uses the compatible 0.0.18 distribution in ../occt-legacy instead.
